result.summary: Fabrication-side the board is in good shape: all 926 tracks are 0.2mm and all 129 vias are 0.6mm/0.3mm (the task premise of 0.4/0.2 vias is stale), which sits inside PCBWay standard 4L capability with no surcharge; the QFN EP paste subdivision on U2/U9 is already correct (~65% coverage) and the 0.4mm-pitch mask webs (0.2mm) clear PCBWay's 4mil bridge minimum. Controlled impedance is not needed (STM32U585 is USB Full-Speed only, ~25mm trace run) so the default 7628/1.2mm-core stackup is fine. Assembly-side the project is NOT ready: the turnkey BOM covers only 16 of 103 footprints, there are zero fiducials, no centroid file, the 42.9x40mm board is below PCBWay's 50x50mm assembly minimum so a tab-routed panel is mandatory (V-score impossible with R2.5 arcs), and finish must be ENIG for the 0.4mm QFN + Tag-Connect pads. Hard fab blockers remain: 69 open connections, ANT1 is a zero-copper placeholder (no NFC antenna exists), DISP1 is parked off-board and would pollute gerber/pos exports, and pcbway-manifest.json/drc.json are stale. Project DRC rules are looser than PCBWay limits in four places and should be tightened before the remaining routing. result.reasoning: Verified against the .kicad_pcb, all schematic sheets, production contracts, and primary ST documents; the finding holds and is actually understated. (1) Board file line 15918: footprint nSealr_Mechanical:NFC_Antenna_Envelope_42x8mm (ANT1) at (32,33) contains 0 pad definitions and 0 graphic/copper primitives (attr board_only exclude_from_pos_files exclude_from_bom) — it is a bare anchor, not even a drawn envelope. Zero gr_* graphics on F.Cu exist anywhere; the string NFC_ANT appears exactly once in the entire PCB (ANT1's Value text), so no NFC_ANT1/NFC_ANT2 nets exist. (2) The gap extends past the coil: U9's pads 13 (RFO1), 15 (RFO2), 22 (RFI1), 23 (RFI2) carry NO nets on the PCB (pin numbers confirmed against DS13541 Rev 11 Fig. 4 p.19: GND_DR1=12/VDD_DR=14/GND_DR2=16 match board GND/NFC_VCC/GND). The schematic U9 symbol in optional_profiles.kicad_sch is an explicit 'source-backed pin subset' with zero RFO/RFI pins, no EMC filter, no matching caps, no RX divider; the sheet itself notes 'Antenna nets remain measurement-gated'. schematic-binding.json marks NFC_ANT1/NFC_ANT2 'explicitly_unbound' while netlist-contract.json required_buses.nfc_spi REQUIRES both nets and gates release on 'nfc_matching_network_measured_with_final_antenna'. (3) The antenna is not optional: DS13541 §2.1 (p.13-14) shows the 'minimum system configuration' includes the antenna coil and EMC filter on RFO1/2-RFI1/2; AN5276 Rev 6 §3 (p.8) defines the mandatory chain RFO1/2 -> EMC filter -> matching network -> antenna, RX via capacitive divider to RFI1/2. (4) Two facts break the recommendation as given: full-board GND pours on F.Cu, B.Cu AND In1.Cu all fill from y=31.6 across the envelope region (a coil drawn on F.Cu over solid planes would be detuned/Q-killed; only existing keepout is elsewhere at x26.7-29.3/y37.9-39.1), and the 42x8 envelope centered at (32,33) spans y=29-37 while the board top edge is y=30.925, so ~1.93mm hangs off-board leaving only ~42x6.1mm usable. There is also no 'U9 matching network' to retune — it must be created from scratch. Full report: /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-vincenzo-Documents-GitHub-nSealr/f269fbe4-0fc9-430f-b7c1-0e1284a83512/scratchpad/pcb-review/reports/dfm-pcbway-ant1-verification.md
result.corrected_recommendation: Do not just 'draw the coil and retune' — there is no matching network to retune; build the RF chain end-to-end. (1) Decide PCB coil vs FPC antenna first (production/placement-plan.json already frames 'FPC OR TUNED KEEP-OUT'); with only ~6.1mm of on-board envelope height and the LiPo directly above the top edge, an enclosure FPC antenna is a serious alternative. (2) Schematic: extend the U9 symbol to the full pin set and add the AN5276 Rev 6 §3 differential chain — EMC filter L_EMC1/2+C_EMC1/2 (§3.3), matching C_S1/2+C_P+R_Q (§3.4), capacitive RX divider into RFI1(22)/RFI2(23) (§3.5) — creating nets NFC_ANT1/NFC_ANT2 exactly as netlist-contract.json required_buses.nfc_spi mandates; seed values from ST's STSW-ST25R004 matching tool. (3) Board: replace the padless ANT1 footprint with a real antenna footprint (two pads on NFC_ANT1/2) fully inside the outline (current envelope y=29-37 vs top edge y=30.925), cut copper+plane keepouts on ALL 4 layers under the coil (the F.Cu/In1.Cu/B.Cu GND pours currently fill to y=31.6 through the envelope), and place EMC filter + matching adjacent to U9 pads 13/15. (4) Treat the first build as a tuning spin: measure the real coil with a network analyzer (AN5276 §4/§7), finalize matching values, and only then consider the existing release gate 'nfc_matching_network_measured_with_final_antenna' passable; keep matching parts 0402/DNP-friendly.

result.reasoning: Claim verified against primary sources. (1) production/bom/pcbway-bom.csv has 15 data rows (16 lines incl. header — the finding's '16' counted the header), and the designator set matches the finding exactly: U1-U5, U7-U11, J1, J2, J6, J9, SW1. (2) board-truth.json placement = 103 footprints; ~78 placed solderable components have no BOM row (all 39 C, 24 R, RJ1/RJ2, RLED1-3, L1 DFE201610P-2R2M, L15 10uH, L30/L31, X1 16MHz, X3 FA-238 27.12MHz, LED1 ASMB-MTB0-0A3A2, D15, U13/U14 TPS22917DBVR, U15 TPS61165DBVR, J7) — every missing item the finding lists is confirmed absent. (3) PCBWay's assembly-file-requirements page (fetched) requires BOM fields incl. 'Reference Designator ... Type (Surface mount, Thru-hole or Hybrid)'; it doesn't literally mandate 'every placed designator + DNP', a slight over-citation, but a 15-row BOM against a ~93-position CPL makes a turnkey quote impossible regardless. The recommendation is however wrong on the source: the schematic sheets contain only 9 symbol instances (J1,J2,J9,SW1,U1,U2,U5,U9,U11 — verified by parsing all .kicad_sch; grep TPS22917 = 0 hits; schematic-coverage.json lists U3/U4/U7/U8/U10 etc. as board-only), so 'regenerate from schematic' would yield 9 rows, worse than today. The BOM must come from the PCB (all 103 footprints carry Value fields) + component-decisions.md. Also: pcbway-manifest required_non_pcba_rows does NOT include JP1 (mis-citation), 6 of its 8 required TP rows reference testpoints not yet on the board, and L30/L31/C30-C33 have placeholder value 'NFC_TUNE' so the BOM cannot be finalized until the NFC matching network is tuned. Full report: /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-vincenzo-Documents-GitHub-nSealr/f269fbe4-0fc9-430f-b7c1-0e1284a83512/scratchpad/pcb-review/reports/dfm-pcbway-bom-coverage-verification.md
result.corrected_recommendation: Regenerate the BOM from the PCB, not the schematic (sheets hold only 9 of 103 symbols; 6 current BOM rows — U3/U4/U7/U8/U10/J6 — have no schematic symbol at all): script over the .kicad_pcb Reference/Value/Footprint fields (all 103 populated) merged with MPNs from design-notes/component-decisions.md, covering all ~93 populated positions; exclude MH1-4 (mounting holes) or list them as hardware. Add the PCBWay-required 'Type (SMD/THT)' column (their assembly-file-requirements field list). Add explicit DNP rows for ANT1, DISP1, JP1 (solder jumper — good practice, though NOT in pcbway-manifest required_non_pcba_rows) and the testpoints, reconciling with pcbway-manifest.json after the 6 missing required testpoints (TP_SWDIO/SWCLK/NRST/BOOT0/3V3/GND) are added to the board. Flag L30, L31, C30-C33 (Value='NFC_TUNE') and ANT1 as value-TBD: the BOM cannot be finalized until the ST25R3916B matching network is tuned. Longer term, complete the schematic so schematic-driven BOM generation and true parity become possible.

result.area: MCU + secure elements (STM32U585, TROPIC01, OPTIGA, W25Q128, USB, SWD/testpoints)
result.summary: The STM32U585 core decoupling plan is genuinely good: one 100nF within 2.4mm of every power pin (9 caps, verified pad-by-pad against DS13086 Fig 15/Fig 24) and a correctly-valued 4.7uF VCAP at 1.9mm; all peripheral pinmux assignments (SPI1/SPI2/SPI3/OCTOSPI1-PE/USB/SWD/USART2/I2C) check out against the LQFP100 pinout and AF tables. However, the HSE circuit is broken as placed (load caps are literal 'HSE_LOAD' placeholders, one sitting 13.7mm away in the VDD decoupling row; no crystal MPN), NRST has no 100nF (DS Fig 38), and the TROPIC01 is missing the 47k CSN pull-up that appears in its own datasheet typical-application, the official devboard, and Trezor Safe 7. OPTIGA and W25Q128 both lack any local VCC decoupling, the VBAT ADC divider exceeds the DS RAIN limit by ~500x, and LED_G sits on PC15 which has no timer AF and is a restricted backup-domain pin. A cross-cutting process gap amplifies everything: the schematic sheets contain only the 11 major parts, so all support passives exist only in the PCB and the BOM has no passives at all. The 6 contract-required testpoints are missing; a concrete DRC-checkable placement around the TC2030 is proposed.

findings.claim: HSE load caps C18/C19 have placeholder value 'HSE_LOAD' and are misplaced: C19 @(26.5,59.5) is 13.7mm from crystal X1 @(14,54) (it sits in the U1 bottom decoupling row), C18 @(14,47.5) is 6.5mm away; X1 itself has no MPN (value '16MHz') so CL is unknowable.
findings.evidence: pads.json measured distances; grep of all .kicad_sch sheets shows C18/C19/X1 exist only in the PCB; ST AN2867 layout guidance and DS13086 Rev10 HSE requirements; production/bom/pcbway-bom.csv contains no passives.
findings.recommendation: Select a 3225 16MHz crystal MPN (CL 8-12pF, ESR<=80Ohm per AN2867 gm margin), set C18/C19 = 2x(CL - ~3pF stray), move both caps adjacent to X1 pads, and shift X1 ~2mm right toward U1 pins 12/13 (pads at 20.325,49.5/50.0).

findings.claim: NRST (U1 pin 14) has no capacitor - only R19 10k pull-up to SYS_3V3 and J7 pin 3; DS requires 100nF placed close to the device for parasitic-reset protection, which matters doubly on a secure device.
findings.evidence: padnets.json net NRST = {R19.1, J7.3, U1.14}; STM32U575/585 DS13086 Rev10 Figure 38 'Recommended NRST pin protection' p.243, note 3: external 0.1uF 'must be placed as close as possible to the device'; internal RPU 30-50k (Table 102) makes R19 redundant.
findings.recommendation: Add 100nF NRST->GND next to U1 pin 14 (free area around (18.5,45.5)); R19 may stay or be removed.

findings.claim: TROPIC01 SPI_CSN (U2 pin 8) has no pull-up: net connects only U2.8 to U1.29 (PA4), so CSN floats whenever the MCU is in reset/boot/low-power while TROPIC_VCC is gated on, risking spurious selects of the secure element.
findings.evidence: TROPIC01 datasheet ODD_TR01 rev A.11 Figure 24 (p.63) shows R1 47k from CSN to VCC in the typical application; TS1702 Mini Board reference schematic carries the same R1 47k 0402; Trezor Safe 7 rev D TROPIC block uses 47k; board padnets.json shows TROPIC_SPI_CSN = {U2.8, U1.29} only.
findings.recommendation: Add 47k from TROPIC_SPI_CSN to TROPIC_VCC (the switched rail after U4/RJ1, NOT SYS_3V3, to avoid back-powering the IO while VCC is gated off; TROPIC01 abs-max IO = 3.6V).

findings.claim: Schematic sheets contain only the 11 major components (U1,U2,U5,U9,U11,J1,J2,J9,SW1...); all ~90 passives, load switches, ESD, crystals, jumpers exist only as PCB footprints, and the fab BOM (16 lines) contains zero passives - placeholder values (HSE_LOAD, NFC_TUNE, BL_SENSE) are unresolvable and nothing passive is procurable.
findings.evidence: grep of '"Reference"' across kicad/sheets/*.kicad_sch (stm32u5_host.kicad_sch contains only U1); production/bom/pcbway-bom.csv designators: U1-U11, J1/J2/J6/J9, SW1 only; 'HSE_LOAD' found only in the .kicad_pcb.
findings.recommendation: Back-annotate the full support network into the sheets (or formally declare the PCB source-of-truth and generate the BOM from board fields), then resolve every placeholder value before the PCBWay package is cut.

findings.claim: OPTIGA Trust M (U11) has no local decoupling: nearest SYS_3V3 cap to VCC pin 10 (pad 16.0,42.0) is C58 at 5.70mm, which is U1 pin-100's own 100nF; C2 4.7uF is 6.26mm away.
findings.evidence: pads.json distance computation; standard Infineon integration practice (OPTIGA Trust M DS Rev 3.70 host-connection figures include a VCC blocking cap).
findings.recommendation: Add 100nF from SYS_3V3 to GND at ~(16.5,40.8), within ~1.5mm of U11 pin 10.

findings.claim: W25Q128JVSIQ (U5) has no local decoupling: nearest cap to VCC pin 8 (pad 19.322,61.654) is C17 2.2uF at 3.64mm, which is also the de-facto bulk for the U1 VDDA corner.
findings.evidence: pads.json distance computation; all nine SYS_3V3 100nF caps (C50-C58) are allocated to U1 power pins.
findings.recommendation: Add 100nF within ~1.5mm of U5 pin 8 (space at ~(20.5,61.0)). Positive note: JVSIQ suffix = QE=1 factory-set (W25Q128JV DS section 7.1.4), so IO2/IO3 direct wiring without pull-ups is correct - pin the exact suffix in the BOM.

findings.claim: VBAT_SENSE divider R20 1M / R21 330k gives ~248kOhm source impedance into ADC1_IN1 (PC0, pin 15) with no reservoir cap; DS Table 106 max RAIN for 14-bit ADC1 tops out at 470 Ohm for the specified sampling times - readings will be invalid.
findings.evidence: STM32U585 DS13086 Rev10 Table 106 p.246 (RAIN max 47-470 Ohm); padnets.json VBAT_SENSE = {R20.2, R21.1, U1.15}, no capacitor on the net.
findings.recommendation: Add 100nF from VBAT_SENSE to GND at the pin (battery voltage is quasi-DC; sample from the reservoir with long sampling time), or rescale the divider to <=10k Thevenin.

findings.claim: VDDA and VREF+ are missing their 1uF caps (only 100nF C52/C53 present at 1.9-2.4mm) and there is no 10uF VDD bulk near U1 - DS power scheme requires 100nF+1uF on each of VDDA and VREF+, and n x 100nF + 1 x 10uF on VDD.
findings.evidence: STM32U585 DS13086 Rev10 Figure 24 p.155 (power supply scheme without SMPS); measured: nearest bulk to the VDDA corner is C17 2.2uF at ~4mm; total scattered rail bulk = 2.2+2.2+4.7uF with buck COUT ~20mm away.
findings.recommendation: Add 2x 1uF 0402 beside C52/C53 (left side, y~53-56) and 1x 10uF 0603 near the U1 bottom row (e.g. beside C59 at (32.5,59.5)).

findings.claim: LED_G is mapped to U1 pin 9 = PC15 (OSC32_OUT): PC15 has no timer alternate function at all (EVENTOUT only), so the ledger's 'PWM colour mixing' is impossible in hardware on that channel, and PC15 is a restricted backup-domain pin (2MHz/30pF, VSW-supplied).
findings.evidence: DS13086 AF table: PC15 row all '-' except EVENTOUT; note p.133: 'PC13,PC14,PC15 supplied through the power switch... must not be used as current sources (e.g. to drive a LED)' (sink at normal capability is allowed per section 5.3.15); pinmux-ledger.json declares PWM mixing and flags pinmux as pending.
findings.recommendation: Move LED_G to a free TIM-capable pin: U1 pins 38/39/40 = PE7/PE8/PE9 are all NC; PE9 = TIM1_CH1 (AF1) is the cleanest. LED_R PE3 = TIM3_CH1 is fine; LED_B PC1 only has LPTIM1_CH1 - consider PE8 (TIM1_CH1N) if uniform TIM PWM is wanted. Freeing PC14/PC15 also re-enables a future LSE crystal.

findings.claim: The six contract-required testpoints TP_3V3/TP_BOOT0/TP_GND/TP_NRST/TP_SWCLK/TP_SWDIO are absent from the board (repo validator red), and TP_UART_TX/RX at (38,52)/(38,53.5) sit 15mm from the debug connector, violating the 'debug features grouped' constraint.
findings.evidence: board-truth.json placement (only TP_UART_* testpoints exist); J7 TC2030 guide holes measured at (25.46,38.5),(30.54,37.48),(30.54,39.52); JP1 pads y 38.75-40.25; U1 top pad row edge y~41.6; C58 at (21.0-22.0,40.5); J6 body ends ~x=22.
findings.recommendation: Add TestPoint_Pad_D1.0mm: TP_SWDIO (26.5,40.5), TP_SWCLK (28.0,40.5), TP_NRST (29.5,40.5) in a row below J7; TP_3V3 (23.0,36.7), TP_GND (23.0,38.3), TP_BOOT0 (23.0,39.9) in a column left of J7; relocate TP_UART_TX/RX to (24.6,38.3)/(24.6,39.9) to complete the cluster. Run DRC; +/-0.3mm slack exists in all directions. Keep TPs out of the final NFC coil area.

findings.claim: USB ESD U7 (TPD4E05U06) is placed 9-11mm right of the J1 D+/D- pads with only pins 1/2 used, so the protection is a long tap/stub and D+/D- must detour ~39mm total versus 15.7mm direct - functionally OK at FS but poor ESD clamping topology and needless congestion while the net is still unrouted.
findings.evidence: pads.json: J1 A6/A7 pads at (31.75/32.25,61.18), U7 pins 1/2 at (40.615,67.5/68.0), R3/R4 at (30/37.5,59.5), U1 PA11/PA12 pads at (35.675,46.5/46.0); USB_DM_CONN is among the 69 open connections.
findings.recommendation: Move U7 inline between J1 signal pads and R3/R4 at ~(33.5,63), flow-through orientation, GND stitched to the In1 plane; reroute D+/D- straight up to PA11/PA12.

findings.claim: TROPIC01 decoupling count matches the datasheet (3x100nF) but all three caps cluster on the south side: pin 24 is served at 1.57mm and pin 22 at 2.12mm, while VCC pin 1 (NE) is 5.46mm and pin 11 (W) is 4.25mm from their nearest cap; no bulk cap on TROPIC_VCC.
findings.evidence: TROPIC01 DS rev A.11 Figure 24 places one 100nF per VCC pin (C1@pin1, C2@pin11, C3@pin24); Trezor Safe 7 rev D adds 4.7uF bulk (C104) beside 3x100nF; measured distances from pads.json.
findings.recommendation: Keep C3 at pin 24, move C5 to the west side for pin 11 and C4 north-east for pin 1; add 2.2-4.7uF on TROPIC_VCC near U2 (TPS22917 CT=1nF slew handles the inrush - note C6 CT-to-VIN wiring is CORRECT per TI TPS22917 DS section 9.3.2). Everything else in the TROPIC block verified good: NU tie-offs exactly match DS Fig 24, power-gate chain U4+R5 47k+RJ1 correct, CSN-to-MCU distance 4.64mm.

findings.claim: U11 uses a Microchip USON-10 proxy footprint with a 1.6x1.6mm exposed pad netted to GND, but the Infineon PG-USON-10-2 package outline shows no exposed pad - paste printed on a nonexistent EP can float/skew the part at reflow. Also the I2C instance split is forced but undocumented: PB8/PB9 (TOUCH) carry only I2C1, so SE2 on PB6/PB7 must use I2C4.
findings.evidence: OPTIGA Trust M DS Rev 3.70 Figure 6 p.15 (package outline, 10 leads, no EP); DS13086 AF table rows: PB8/PB9 I2C1 only (AF4), PB6/PB7 I2C1 or I2C4; board footprint 'Microchip_USON-10-1EP_3x3mm_P0.5mm_EP1.6x1.6mm'.
findings.recommendation: Swap to a true PG-USON-10-2 footprint or delete the EP pad/paste aperture; record 'SE2 = I2C4 on PB6/PB7, TOUCH = I2C1 on PB8/PB9' in production/pinmux-ledger.json. Pinout, RST internal pull-up handling, and software-only hibernate are all verified correct; 4.7k pull-ups fine for 400kHz.

findings.claim: Series 22R resistors R3/R4 on USB D+/D- are not required by ST: the STM32U5 OTG_FS has an on-chip FS PHY with embedded output impedance and DP pull-up, and ST reference designs use direct connection; 22R will slightly soften FS edges.
findings.evidence: DS13086 section 3.50 'embed a USB OTG full-speed... with integrated transceivers / On-chip full-speed PHY'; ST AN4879 USB hardware guidelines (no external series R for FS, integrated 1.5k DP pull-up).
findings.recommendation: Change R3/R4 to 0R but keep the footprints (rework option); no external DP pull-up needed. Also note USB_VBUS_SENSE (PA9, FT pin) sees ~4.55V through the 100k/1M divider - legal as digital detect (abs max min(VDD+4,6)V with VDD up, Table 21) but PA9 has no ADC channel, so document that VBUS measurement was not the intent.

findings.claim: J7 TC2030 pin 6 (SWO position in the standard ARM TC2030-CTX map) is unconnected while U1 pin 89 (PB3 = TRACESWO) is NC - free ITM/SWO trace capability is being left on the table.
findings.evidence: pads.json J7 pad 6 net None; padnets.json U1 pin 89 = NC; DS13086 AF table PB3 AF0 = JTDO/TRACESWO; J7 pins 1-5 verified as standard VTref/SWDIO/NRST/SWCLK/GND.
findings.recommendation: Route PB3 (U1 pin 89) to J7 pin 6 before completing the top-area routing.

findings.claim: OCTOSPI1 (Port E, PE10-15) to W25Q128 CLK pad-to-pad distance is 12.1mm with QSPI_CLK and QSPI_IO2 still unrouted; fine for 48-80MHz SDR but needs matched routing.
findings.evidence: pads.json U5.6 (19.322,64.194) to U1.41 (29.5,57.675) = 12.09mm; ST AN5050 OCTOSPI layout guidance; DS13086 section 5.3.34.
findings.recommendation: When closing the 69 open nets, match CLK/NCS/IO0-3 lengths within a few mm and keep them referenced to the In1 GND plane; no series termination needed at this length and target clock.

result.summary: The power tree exists only in the PCB netlist (schematic sheets are stubs; BOM lists majors only): USB-C J1 -> TPS2553 (U8) -> BQ24074 power-path charger (U10) -> SYS_PWR_IN -> TPS62840 3.3V buck (U3) + TPS61165 backlight boost (U15), with three TPS22917 islands (TROPIC/NFC/display). IC pin mappings are essentially all correct (BQ24074, TPS2553, TPS62840, TPS22917 incl. QOD-to-VOUT, TPS61165) and the current budget verdict is that the TPS62840 750mA buck is ADEQUATE (~460-580mA worst realistic, backlight correctly NOT on 3.3V). However the design has one broken topology (boost driving a 4-parallel-LED 3.2V backlight from a 4.4V node: cannot regulate, ~4x LED overdrive, backlight cannot be switched off), mis-programmed resistors (788mA charge into a 150-300mAh battery; 1.36A charger input limit above the 0.96A front-end switch and the 500mA USB budget), systematic missing/misplaced power capacitors (zero cap on charger IN and BAT, 1uF-only on OUT, buck output cap 37.6mm away, NFC rail 100nF-only at 12.4mm), an ST25R3916B VDD_RF/VDD_DR strap matching neither datasheet configuration, and a TROPIC01 VCC ramp (1.6ms via CT=1nF) violating its 1ms limit. Trezor Safe 7 (same TROPIC01+ST25R3916B) uses an nPM1300 PMIC and a series-string backlight boost, validating our part choices but not the backlight wiring. All fixable at schematic/value level before routing completion.

findings.claim: TPS61165 boost backlight topology is invalid for the ER-TFT024IPS-3 panel: 4 parallel LEDs (common anode, Vf~3.2V, 80mA total) need VOUT~3.4V while VIN=SYS_PWR_IN is 4.4V on USB (BQ24074 VO(REG)) and 3.0-4.2V on battery; a boost cannot regulate below VIN, the DC path VIN->L15(49,63.5)->D15(46.5,67.5)->LEDA overdrives LEDs ~4x, and the backlight cannot be hardware-disabled (no load disconnect) whenever SYS_PWR_IN>~3.55V
findings.evidence: J2 pads 1=TFT_BACKLIGHT_A, 2-5=TFT_BACKLIGHT_K to U15.6 FB; design-notes/subsystem-7-display.md ('4 LED strings, Vf 3.2 V, 80 mA total', LEDA FFC1, LEDK1-4 FFC2-5); TPS61165 DS SLVS790E (series-LED boost, FB=200mV); BQ24074 DS SLUS810N VO(REG)=4.3/4.4/4.5V
findings.recommendation: Replace U15/L15/D15/C13/C15/R15 with a 4-channel current-sink or charge-pump WLED driver running from SYS_PWR_IN with PWM dimming; fallback is re-feeding a boost from SYS_3V3 (degenerate 3.3->3.4V duty, adds ~90-100mA to buck budget) - inferior

findings.claim: Fast-charge current is programmed to 788mA (R10 ISET=1.13k, ICHG=890/1130) which is 2.6-5.3C for the 150-300mAh LiPo that fits the 42.7x19.3mm battery bay; also >1.2W linear dissipation in the VQFN16 causing thermal-loop throttling
findings.evidence: U10.16 net CHARGER_ISET -> R10 1.13k@(44.5,45) to GND; BQ24074 DS SLUS810N: ICHG=KISET/RISET, KISET=890 AOhm (797-975); mechanical-architecture.md battery bay 42.72 x ~19.3mm
findings.recommendation: Choose battery first, then R10=890/ICHG: 3.57k for 250mA (250mAh@1C) or 5.9k for 150mA; recompute R12 ITERM=RISET*ITERM/0.030 (e.g. 2.94k for 25mA); R11 46.4k timer (6.2h) can stay

findings.claim: Current-limit chain is inverted: BQ24074 input limit 1.36A (R9 ILIM=1.18k, 1610/1180) exceeds the upstream TPS2553 limit 0.89-1.04A (R8=27k) which exceeds the USB-C default 500mA the Rd-only sink (R1/R2 5.1k, no CC sensing) is allowed to draw - the front-end switch will current-limit/thermal-cycle during charging and compliant ports will sag
findings.evidence: U10.12->R9 1.18k; U8.5->R8 27k; BQ24074 DS KILIM=1610 (1500-1720); TPS2553 DS IOSnom=23950/RILIM^0.977 mA -> 957mA at 27k; J1 CC1/CC2 only have 5.1k Rd to GND (R1,R2), USB_CC nets not routed to MCU ADC
findings.recommendation: Set R9=3.24k (IINmax~497mA, USB-compliant) and keep R8=27k as backstop; only raise after adding CC-level detection (BQ24074 EN1/EN2 are hardwired to ILIM mode so 500mA is the practical ceiling)

findings.claim: Charger capacitors missing/undersized: VBUS_LIMITED (BQ24074 IN pin13) has ZERO capacitance (DS requires 1-10uF), VBAT (BAT pins 2/3) has NO capacitor (DS requires 4.7-47uF), OUT/SYS_PWR_IN has only C14 1uF@(50,39) (DS requires 4.7-47uF) which is simultaneously the only input cap for TPS62840 (needs 4.7uF, 10.1mm away) and TPS61165 (needs 4.7uF, 20.0mm away)
findings.evidence: Net extraction: VBUS_LIMITED={R23.1,U10.13,U8.6}; VBAT={J9.1,R20.1,U10.2,U10.3}; SYS_PWR_IN sole cap C14 1uF; BQ24074 DS Pin Functions IN/BAT/OUT bypass requirements; TPS62840 DS 'A 4.7-uF ceramic capacitor is required' at VIN
findings.recommendation: Add 4.7uF at U10 pin13, 4.7-10uF at U10 BAT/J9, 10uF at U10 OUT; 4.7uF at U3 VIN pins 2/4; 4.7uF at backlight-driver VIN - each within 1-2mm of the pin

findings.claim: TPS62840 output capacitor is effectively absent at the converter: only SYS_3V3 bulk is C2 4.7uF at (13,36.5), 37.6mm from U3@(48.44,49) (L1->C2 34.3mm), violating both the 10uF minimum (Table 3 for 2.2uH) and the VOS short-trace requirement; buck stability/ripple not guaranteed
findings.evidence: TPS62840 DS SLVSEC6D Table 3 (2.2uH + 10uF/22uF), VOS pin note 'Connect this pin directly to the output capacitor with a short trace'; measured distances from fp-nets.json coordinates
findings.recommendation: Place 10uF X5R directly at L1.2/VOS(U3.8); keep C2 as remote bulk near the MCU corner

findings.claim: ST25R3916B driver supply strap matches neither documented configuration: VDD_DR (U9 pin14) is tied to raw NFC_VCC while VDD_RF (pin9) floats on its own 100nF (C38) - datasheet requires either VDD_RF externally tied to VDD_DR (regulator mode, recommended) or BOTH VDD_RF and VDD_DR tied to VDD_TX (bypass mode for >350mArms)
findings.evidence: U9 pad14=NFC_VCC, pad9=NFC_VDD_RF (cap-only net); ST25R3916B DS13541 Rev11: 'If a transmitter output current higher than 350 mArms is required ... VDD_RF and VDD_DR have to be externally connected to VDD_TX'; ST antenna appnote figure ties VDD_RF-VDD_DR
findings.recommendation: Disconnect U9 pin14 from NFC_VCC and tie it to the NFC_VDD_RF net with 1uF+100nF local; use Adjust Regulators at init (best PSRR at 3.3V)

findings.claim: TROPIC01 VCC rise time violates the datasheet 1ms ramp limit: TPS22917 with CT=C6=1nF gives tR ~1.6ms (1.6us/pF at VIN 3.6V, slower at 3.3V) vs TROPIC01 TVCC_RAMPUP <= 1ms
findings.evidence: TROPIC01 DS Rev A.11 section 9.1 (TVCCRAMPUP 1ms max); TPS22917 DS SLVSDW8B switching characteristics tR=1.6us/pF at 3.6V; C6 1nF on TROPIC_SW_CT->SYS_3V3
findings.recommendation: Change C6 to 470pF (tR~0.75ms); inrush stays ~1.3mA since downstream is only 3x100nF (C3-C5)

findings.claim: NFC power rail decoupling grossly inadequate: NFC_VCC (VDD+VDD_TX+VDD_IO+VDD_DR) has only C41 100nF at 12.4mm from U9 despite 350mArms (500mA peak abs-max) TX bursts; all internal-regulator bypass caps are scattered 8.8-12.2mm from the QFN32 (C36 VDD_D 10.7mm, C37 VDD_A 9.5mm, C38 VDD_RF 8.8mm, C39 VDD_AM 11.5mm, C40 AGDC 12.2mm)
findings.evidence: fp-nets.json distances; ST25R3916B DS Table 122 (IVDD_LDO 350mA, IVDD_EXT 500mA peak) and minimum-system-configuration figures with per-pin bypass
findings.recommendation: Add 10uF+1uF+100nF on NFC_VCC at U9 supply pins; move C36-C40 to within ~1mm of pins 3/7/9/11/24 during re-floorplan

findings.claim: VBUS front-end layout/protection: the only VBUS cap C1 10uF sits at (28,35.5) - 31.0mm from J1 and 32.9mm from U8 (TPS2553 requires >=0.1uF at IN close to IC, abs max 7V) - and there is no TVS on VBUS (U7 TPD4E05U06 covers only D+/D-/CC1/CC2)
findings.evidence: fp-nets.json: VBUS={C1.1,J1.A4/A9/B4/B9,U8.1,U8.3}; TPS2553 DS pin table IN bypass requirement and abs-max 7V; U7 pads 1,2,4,5 = DP/DM/CC1/CC2 only
findings.recommendation: Move C1 adjacent to J1 VBUS pads, add 100nF at U8 pin1, add a 5V working-voltage TVS (SMF5.0A-class) at the connector

findings.claim: NFC_PWR_EN and TFT_PWR_EN have no pulldowns - TPS22917 ON pin must not float, but both nets are bare MCU-pin-to-switch (U1.36-U13.3, U1.66-U14.3), so NFC and display rails are in undefined state during NRST/BOOT0-DFU/firmware crash (TROPIC correctly has R5 47k)
findings.evidence: Net extraction; TPS22917 DS pin table: ON 'Do not leave floating'; TS1701 Mini Board reference uses 47k on the equivalent enable
findings.recommendation: Add 100k pulldowns on NFC_PWR_EN and TFT_PWR_EN (default-off islands match the security posture)

findings.claim: TOUCH_I2C_SCL/SDA (shared FT6336 touch + J6 Qwiic bus) have no pull-up resistors anywhere - the bus cannot function; subsystem-7 note specifies 4.7k to 3V3 but they were never instantiated (R6/R7 4.7k belong to the SE2 bus)
findings.evidence: Net extraction: TOUCH_I2C_SCL={J2.44,J6.4,U1.95}, TOUCH_I2C_SDA={J2.45,J6.3,U1.96}; design-notes/subsystem-7-display.md '4.7 kOhm pull-ups on SCL/SDA to +3V3'
findings.recommendation: Add 4.7k pull-ups to SYS_3V3; document that display power-gating back-feeds FT6336 weakly via SDA/SCL (bus is shared with always-on J6) and verify leakage at bring-up

findings.claim: DISPLAY_VCC_SW rail (ST7789V VCI/VDDI via 6 J2 pins) has zero decoupling between the U14 load switch and the FFC
findings.evidence: Net extraction: DISPLAY_VCC_SW={J2.7,8,9,40,41,42,U14.5,U14.6} - no capacitor on the net
findings.recommendation: Add 2.2uF+100nF at U14 VOUT and 1uF near the J2 VCI/VDDI pins

findings.claim: Backlight components are value placeholders: R15 value='BL_SENSE' (sets LED current, I=200mV/R15), D15 value='D_SCHOTTKY' (no PN), L15 generic '10uH' - the rail is unbuildable as drawn
findings.evidence: Footprint values from PCB: R15@(49,56.5)='BL_SENSE', D15@(46.5,67.5)='D_SCHOTTKY'; TPS61165 DS FB=200mV
findings.recommendation: Resolve together with P1 (topology replacement supersedes these parts); never leave value placeholders in a fab-bound BOM

findings.claim: Current budget verdict: TPS62840 (750mA) is ADEQUATE, not undersized - worst realistic concurrent SYS_3V3 load ~460-580mA (MCU 20-40, TROPIC peak 25 per DS 9.2, QSPI 25, OPTIGA 15 HW-limited, NFC TX 250-350 in regulator mode, display logic+touch ~25, Qwiic capped 100); backlight is correctly on SYS_PWR_IN not on the 3.3V rail, avoiding the boost-input-current trap
findings.evidence: TROPIC01 DS 9.2 (peak 24.9mA); OPTIGA Trust M DS (ICC 14mA avg, limitable 6-15mA); ST25R3916B DS (IAL 23mA + <=350mArms driver); U15.1/L15.1/LED1.1 on SYS_PWR_IN per netlist; Trezor Safe 7 rev D uses nPM1300 PMIC + TPS61062 with the same TROPIC01+ST25R3916B
findings.recommendation: Keep TPS62840; enforce NFC regulator mode <=350mArms (P6) and a documented 100mA Qwiic budget; no part change needed

findings.claim: J6 Qwiic is described as 'power-limited 3V3' in the BOM note but connects SYS_3V3 directly with no fuse/limiter - an external short takes down the whole system rail
findings.evidence: J6.2=SYS_3V3 direct (net extraction); production BOM note 'power-limited 3V3'
findings.recommendation: Add a 100-200mA polyfuse or small load switch on J6 power, or amend the contract note

findings.claim: VBAT_SENSE divider R20 1M/R21 330k is hardwired (3.2uA permanent battery drain - acceptable) but its 248k source impedance is too high for the STM32 ADC without a sampling cap; USB_VBUS_SENSE (R23 100k series + R24 1M to PA9) is a valid 5V-tolerant digital detect
findings.evidence: Nets VBAT_SENSE={R20.2,R21.1,U1.15}, USB_VBUS_SENSE={R23.2,R24.1,U1.68=PA9}; STM32U5 ADC RAIN limits
findings.recommendation: Add 100nF from VBAT_SENSE to GND at the MCU pin

findings.claim: Sequencing checks pass with caveats: ST25R3916B digital pins 27-32 are rated -0.3..6V independent of VDD_IO so NFC power-gating with MCU SPI idling high is abs-max safe; TROPIC01 IO abs-max is 3.6V absolute (not VCC-referenced) so power-cycling is not an explicit violation; TPS22917 QOD-tied-to-VOUT gives proper rail collapse for TROPIC01 recovery
findings.evidence: ST25R3916B DS Table 122 VpIO -0.3..6V; TROPIC01 DS Table 19 'Voltage on IO pins 3.6V'; TPS22917 DS QOD pin options
findings.recommendation: Firmware should still park TROPIC and NFC SPI lines low during power-down of the respective island (back-injection behavior unspecified by Tropic Square); no hardware change required

findings.claim: Production BOM (bom/pcbway-bom.csv) omits most of the power subsystem: U13, U14, U15, L1, L15, D15, LED1, X1, X3, and every resistor/capacitor - only 16 major line items are present
findings.evidence: pcbway-bom.csv contents vs 103 footprints in the PCB
findings.recommendation: Regenerate the BOM from the board after the P1-P5 value fixes land; block fab export until designator counts match
